blocks.prompt: 4 (a) An investment grows according to the function \(A(t) = 10000(1 + 0.05t)^3\), where \(A(t)\) is the value of the investment and \(t\) is the time in years. Find the rate of change of the investment after 8 years.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh rate of change ka sawal hai: 8 saal baad investment kitni tezi se barh rahi hai.
Humein \(A'(8)\) find karna hai.
Plan: \(A(t)\) ko powers of \(t\) mein kholna, differentiate karna, phir \(t = 8\) rakhna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(A(t) = 10000(1 + 0.05t)^3\).
Humein find karna hai: \(A'(8)\).
Tareeqa: Rate of change \(= A'(t)\). Cube khol kar power rule lagayenge.

Cube ko kholein
\[(1 + 0.05t)^3 = 1 + 0.15t + 0.0075t^2 + 0.000125t^3\]
\[A(t) = 10000 + 1500t + 75t^2 + 1.25t^3\]
Kyun: \((1 + b)^3 = 1 + 3b + 3b^2 + b^3\), jahan \(b = 0.05t\): \(3b = 0.15t\), \(3b^2 = 3(0.0025t^2) = 0.0075t^2\), \(b^3 = 0.000125t^3\). Phir har term ko 10000 se guna kiya. Ab sirf power rule kaafi hai; kitab ke rules mein bracket ki power ka koi alag qaida nahi, is liye kholna mehfooz rasta hai.

Differentiate karein
\[A'(t) = 1500 + 150t + 3.75t^2\]
Kyun: Constant 10000 ka derivative zero, \(1500t \to 1500\), \(75t^2 \to 150t\), \(1.25t^3 \to 3.75t^2\).

\(t = 8\) rakhein
\[A'(8) = 1500 + 1200 + 240 = 2940\]
Kyun: \(150 \times 8 = 1200\) aur \(3.75 \times 64 = 240\). Matlab 8 saal ke baad investment taqreeban 2940 fi saal ki raftaar se barh rahi hai.

Tasdeeq: factorised shakal se
\[A'(t) = 1500(1 + 0.05t)^2\]
\[A'(8) = 1500(1.4)^2 = 1500 \times 1.96 = 2940\]
Kyun: \(1500(1 + 0.1t + 0.0025t^2)\) kholein to wohi \(1500 + 150t + 3.75t^2\) aata hai. Dono tareeqon se 2940, to jawab pakka.

blocks.prompt: 4 (b) An investment grows according to the function \(A(t) = 10000(1 + 0.05t)^3\), where \(A(t)\) is the value of the investment and \(t\) is the time in years. What is the investment value after 8 years?
blocks.explanation:
Is part mein derivative ki zaroorat nahi, sirf value nikalni hai.
Humein \(A(8)\) find karna hai, yani 8 saal baad investment ki kul qeemat.
Plan: \(t = 8\) ko \(A(t)\) mein rakhna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(A(t) = 10000(1 + 0.05t)^3\).
Humein find karna hai: \(A(8)\).
Tareeqa: Kisi waqt par value function mein woh waqt rakhne se milti hai.
Dhyan dein: Part (a) rate (\(A'\)) poochhta hai aur part (b) value (\(A\)); dono ko mila dena aam ghalti hai.

blocks.prompt: 4 (c) An investment grows according to the function \(A(t) = 10000(1 + 0.05t)^3\), where \(A(t)\) is the value of the investment and \(t\) is the time in years. Determine the time at which the investment is growing the fastest.
blocks.explanation:
Humein dekhna hai ke growth rate \(A'(t)\) kab sab se zyada hota hai.
Yeh "maximum" wala sawal hai, lekin is dafa maximum growth rate ka.
Plan: \(A'(t)\) ka apna rate of change dekhna; agar woh hamesha positive ho to \(A'(t)\) barhta hi rehta hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(A'(t) = 1500 + 150t + 3.75t^2 = 1500(1 + 0.05t)^2\), \(t \ge 0\).
Humein find karna hai: sab se tez growth ka waqt.
Tareeqa: Growth rate \(A'(t)\) hai. Agar yeh hamesha barhta rahe to koi aisa waqt nahi jahan yeh sab se zyada ho; har agla saal pichhle se tez hoga.

Growth rate ka rate of change
\[\frac{d}{dt}A'(t) = 150 + 7.5t\]
Kyun: \(A'(t)\) par dobara power rule: \(150t \to 150\), \(3.75t^2 \to 7.5t\).

Is ka sign
\[150 + 7.5t > 0 \text{ for all } t \ge 0\]
Kyun: Dono terms positive hain, to yeh kabhi zero ya negative nahi hota. Matlab \(A'(t)\) hamesha barh raha hai, aur \(t \ge 0\) mein us ki koi choti nahi.

Natija
\[A'(0) = 1500,\ A'(8) = 2940,\ A'(20) = 6000\]
Kyun: Waqt ke saath growth rate barhta hi ja raha hai. Compound growth ki yahi khoobi hai: jitna zyada waqt, utni tez barhotri. Is liye jawab yeh hai ke koi khaas lamha nahi; waqt barhne ke saath rate barhta hai (answer key bhi yahi kehti hai).
blocks.final_answer: Koi finite waqt nahi: waqt barhne ke saath growth ka rate barhta hai

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key ne Exercise 13.3 ke jawabat ko 1 se 8 ke bajaye 4, 5, 6, 8, 11, 12, 13, 14 number diye hain. Is sawal ka jawab number 8 par chhapa hai: (a) 2940, (b) 27440, (c) "as time increases rate increases", sab sahi.
